title: 研究级数学问题的智能体系统RMA
summary: 提出Research Math Agents (RMA)框架，专为研究级数学问题设计。通过多角色、多轮协作的智能体（初始化、提议、验证）分解问题、搜索文献、构建知识库并迭代精炼证明。在First Proof基准上解决10个问题中的8个，超越GPT-5.2R等基线。
summary_en: Introduces Research Math Agents (RMA), an agentic framework for research-level math problems. It decomposes proof solving into specialized modules coordinated by multi-role agents. On the First Proof benchmark, RMA solves 8 out of 10 problems, outperforming GPT-5.2R and Aletheia.
